# Working with me

- I am a backend developer; most of my work is in Go and TypeScript services.
- Always run the full test suite before you say a change is done.
- Never commit with `--no-verify`; fix what the hook found instead.

## Tools

- Staging deploys go through `make deploy-staging`, never by hand.
- The team's runbooks live in the `ops-handbook` repository.
